question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- All bowlers with 0.0 bowling average
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_from_bat
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_extras AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, SUM(er.extra_runs) as extra_runs_charged
    FROM extra_runs er
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON er.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND er.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND er.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND er.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE er.extra_type IN ('wides', 'noballs', 'penalty')
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT 
    br.bowler,
    p.player_name,
    bw.wickets,
    br.runs_from_bat + COALESCE(be.extra_runs_charged, 0) as total_runs_conceded,
    ROUND(1.0 * (br.runs_from_bat + COALESCE(be.extra_runs_charged, 0)) / bw.wickets, 2) as bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
LEFT JOIN bowler_extras be ON br.bowler = be.bowler
LEFT JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 10

-- First, let's check how many wickets each bowler has taken
SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
FROM wicket_taken wt
JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id 
    AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id 
    AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
    AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
GROUP BY bb.bowler
ORDER BY wickets DESC
